subject: craft
angle: Why craft paper takes some inks and refuses others
caption:
Thin black ink feathers into raw craft fibers within seconds, while opaque pigment stays right where we lay it down.

· Uncoated craft pulp drinks dye-based inks fast
· Pigment inks dry resting on top of grain
· Crisp QR codes need dense matte contrast
· Tiny script fonts bleed without enough spacing

Send us a DM with your motif po and we can test how it sits on brown board.
